item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01670","case1_error":"Correct cost and equal-share formulas are followed by unsupported incorrect numbers; the required share is $25.","case2_error":"Divides revenue remaining after wages by 10 instead of dividing the wage allocation by 10.","reason":"Case 1 supplies unsupported numbers after correct formulas; case 2 calculates the wrong quantity using correctly evaluated arithmetic.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01671","case1_error":"Subtracts car spending from the console price instead of subtracting available savings from that price.","case2_error":"Omits the additional 20% bulk discount when calculating total savings.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect relation for the funding shortfall; case 2 leaves out an explicitly required discount.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01672","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from rim height although the required reach is six inches above it.","case2_error":"Counts each win as one point instead of the specified two points.","reason":"Case 1 reverses the direction of a height offset; case 2 omits the required weighting of wins.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01673","case1_error":"Assigns two legs to each of the other walker's dogs, then rounds the resulting noninteger dog count.","case2_error":"Uses the combined south-and-east subtotal as the south distance, counting the east distance twice.","reason":"Case 1 applies an incorrect per-dog leg count; case 2 double-counts a component already included in a subtotal.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01674","case1_error":"Treats the third of Frank's apples sold as the number remaining.","case2_error":"Treats the 80% payable amount as the discount and subtracts it from the full price.","reason":"Both confuse a specified portion with its complement, exchanging the amount removed and the amount retained or paid.","judgment":"same"}]}
